item.title: Social Media Erupts After USA Hockey Wins First Gold Medal Since 1980
item.description: Facing a juggernaut of Canadian forwards in arguably the most talented Olympic final in history, Jack Hughes overtime winner sent social media into a frenzy as the Americans captured gold.

item.title: US men’s hockey gold medal and Eileen Gu’s halfpipe victory highlight final day of Winter Olympics
item.description: Jack Hughes’ overtime goal against Canada gave the United States its first Olympic gold medal in men’s hockey since 1980.

item.title: “One Battle After Another” wins six prizes including best picture at Britain’s BAFTA film awards
item.description: Politically charged action thriller “One Battle After Another” has won six prizes including best picture at Britain’s BAFTA film awards. Vampire saga “Sinners” and gothic horror story “Frankenstein” each won three prizes.

item.title: How the next Olympics will be different from Utah’s vision
item.description: MILAN – At the end of the closing ceremony and Olympic handover, the French Alps will officially be the next Winter Olympic host. item.title: Some locals worry Olympic Games could forever change Cortina
item.description: Along with construction for the Olympic games, some people in Cortina noticed a number of high-class hotels, restaurants, and shops moving in. Now, they're worried they could be setting the new standard for who can afford to play and vacation there.

item.title: Tabernacle Choir heads to São Paulo for sixth stop on global “Songs of Hope” Tour
item.description: The Tabernacle Choir at Temple Square is traveling thousands of miles away from Salt Lake for the sixth stop on its world tour.

item.title: Mexican army kills leader of powerful Jalisco New Generation Cartel during operation to capture him
item.description: The Mexican army killed the leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, Nemesio Rubén Oseguera Cervantes, “El Mencho,” on Sunday, decapitating what had become Mexico’s most powerful cartel.

item.title: Avalanche in Snake Creek leaves snowmobiler missing
item.description: An avalanche happened in the Snake Creek area west of Midway Sunday afternoon.

item.description: When it comes to Olympic pins, people who are into it are really into it.

item.title: ‘The status quo is not working’: Lawmakers reject plan designed to build more starter homes
item.description: Utah’s zoning practices have made homebuilding more expensive and burdensome, a Republican lawmaker told his colleagues, urging their support for a bill he said would change things in a “small way” to try to get more starter homes built.
